title: Heliacal 5/8: TopoArcVisionis + HeliacalAngle + public wrappers
description:
### Summary
Port the arcus-visionis bisection (TopoArcVisionis) and the optimum-altitude search (HeliacalAngle), plus their public wrappers `swe_topo_arcus_visionis` → `Ephemeris::topo_arcus_visionis` and `swe_heliacal_angle` → `Ephemeris::heliacal_angle`.

Read docs/codebase-map.md first. Do NOT read ../swisseph C source.

### Files
- `src/heliacal.rs` — `topo_arc_visionis` core, `heliacal_angle_core`, public `topo_arcus_visionis` / `heliacal_angle`.
- `src/context.rs` — two delegates (after `vis_limit_mag`).
- `src/lib.rs` — re-export any new output type.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_heliacal.c` — extend with `"arcvis"` and `"helangle"` keys; regenerate heliacal.json.
- `tests/golden/heliacal.rs` — extend.

### Implementation steps
1. `topo_arc_visionis` per docs/c-ref-heliacal-vision.md §9: bisection over Sun-depression with the exact bracket, iteration/convergence constants, and sign convention §9 gives (the catalogue's [45°,0°] summary is a paraphrase — follow §9). Each probe evaluates object magnitude minus vis_lim_magn at the trial geometry; reuse the 4/8 core, threading the same dobs/datm/helflag.
2. Public `topo_arcus_visionis(eph, tjd_ut, dgeo, datm, dobs, epheflag, helflag, mag, azi_obj, alt_obj, azi_sun, azi_moon, alt_moon) -> Result<f64, Error>` per §9's wrapper walkthrough (dret[0] only).
3. `heliacal_angle_core` per §10: the optimum-altitude scan (which altitudes it samples, the parabola/minimum selection, and the dret[0..2] = [optimal altitude, arcus visionis, Sun-altitude-difference] contract per §10). The PLSV==1 branch is DEAD (vision §11) — skip it.
4. Public `heliacal_angle(...)` per §10 (same parameter shape minus alt_obj). Output: `[f64; 3]` or a small named struct — pick a named struct `HeliacalAngle { optimal_altitude, arcus_visionis, sun_altitude_diff }` for lib.rs re-export (matches project convention of named outputs, e.g. Phenomena).
5. Delegates in context.rs + lib.rs re-exports.
6. Extend gen_heliacal.c: `"arcvis"` — swe_topo_arcus_visionis over mag ∈ {-4.6, -1.46, 0.5, 2.0} × (azi_obj,alt_obj) ∈ {(120,10),(240,3)} × (azi_sun,azi_moon,alt_moon) ∈ {(90,270,-10),(300,60,20)} × tjd_ut ∈ {2453371.0, 2451545.0} × Cairo dgeo × default datm/dobs × SEFLG_SWIEPH — record retval + dret[0]. `"helangle"` — swe_heliacal_angle over the same grid minus alt_obj — record retval + dret[0..2]. ~32 cases total (rotate, don't full-cross).
7. Regenerate heliacal.json; extend tests/golden/heliacal.rs. Tolerance: bisection converges to §9's epsilon — assert eps 1e-6 on angles (tighten to 1e-7 if it passes).

### C reference
docs/c-ref-heliacal-vision.md §9, §10 (+§8 core contract, §11 porting notes).

### Golden tests
- Same gen_heliacal build/run as 4/8.
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal -- --nocapture`.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal -- --nocapture` passes (vis_limit battery from 4/8 must still pass after regeneration).
- `cargo test` full suite green; no new clippy warnings.

### Escape hatch
If golden tests fail with errors > 1e-5 (angles) after two debugging attempts, STOP and report failing cases, actual vs expected, what you tried. Escalate to Opus.

messages.text: Codex review: approve with notes. Two findings fixed in 0500d3d: (1) topo_arcus_visionis now returns Result<f64, Error> for API consistency with neighboring wrappers, (2) suppressed dead_code warnings on unused retval fields in test structs.
